resources.string: Feed Guard
Feed Guard

Covers Instagram and Reddit pages in Firefox whenever the Reddit NSFW Blocker add-on isn't running on them. It reads Firefox's address bar and a marker the add-on puts on those pages. For other apps it reads only which app is on screen, to keep maps in colour while the rest stays black and white, and to notice a bank app opening. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.

If you turn this off, Feed Guard turns it back on once it has the secure settings permission. Without that permission, Firefox is paused until you turn it back on.

Bank apps such as Nubank refuse to open while this is on. So when one opens, Feed Guard turns this and Watch Limit off for 10 minutes (banking mode), with Firefox and YouTube paused meanwhile, then turns both back on.
Open bank app
Bank apps (banking mode)

Package names, separated by commas. Bank apps refuse to open while Feed Guard and Watch Limit are on. While one of these opens, Feed Guard switches both off for 10 minutes, with Firefox and YouTube paused meanwhile, then switches them back on. Unset, it\'s Nubank. Write none to turn banking mode off.
Apps to leave alone (your list)

Package names, separated by commas. Feed Guard never pauses these and lifts its own pause on them. With \u201cOnly apps on the list\u201d on, these are the only apps that open. Feed Guard\'s \u201cPick apps for your list\u201d button copies names to paste here.
Only apps on the list
Pause every app that isn\'t on the list above, apart from the phone\'s basics: calls, texts, contacts, the clock, the keyboard, settings and OwnDroid. Fill in the list first.
Black and white
Keep the screen black and white, except while only a colour app is on screen. Needs the secure settings permission, given over adb. On unless turned off here.
Apps shown in colour
Package names, separated by commas. Unset, it\'s Google Maps, CoMaps and Organic Maps. Write none for no colour at all.
Extra apps to pause
Package names, separated by commas. Paused like other browsers.
Morning news block
After the phone has been left alone overnight, the first unlock in the morning turns news off for a while: news sites are covered in Firefox and news apps are paused. On unless turned off here.
Morning news block: hours left alone
How many hours the phone must go untouched (screen off, or lit only by notifications) to count as a night\'s sleep. Unset, it\'s 6.
Morning news block: from hour
The first unlock counts as waking up only from this hour, 0 to 23. Unset, it\'s 6 (6 AM).
Morning news block: until hour
... and before this hour, 0 to 23. Unset, it\'s 12 (noon).
Morning news block: minutes
How long news stays off, in minutes, at most 240. Unset, it\'s 60. Time the phone is switched off doesn\'t count.
Morning news block: sites

Web addresses, separated by commas. Each covers its subdomains too, so globo.com covers g1.globo.com. Unset, it\'s Feed Guard\'s list of Brazilian and international news sites. Write none for no sites.
Morning news block: apps

Package names, separated by commas. Paused during the block, even if they\'re on your list. Apps that call themselves news apps are paused too. Unset, it\'s Feed Guard\'s list (Google News, g1, CNN, BBC News and others, plus YouTube ReVanced). Write none for only the apps that call themselves news apps.
